edit.description: each file kind's locus doc cites the doc section naming the paths its loader reads, retrieved current

summary: Every built-in file locus carries a current cite for the paths the harness loads as that kind
acceptance: every built-in file kind's locus comment cites a code.claude.com page and a 2026-11 retrieval date that documents exactly that locus
notes: Per 0084 Consequences: a locus is only as current as its cite. Cite-only: a locus the current docs contradict (e.g. commands in subdirectories) is not moved here — file it as a build note naming the doc quote, so the move gets its own entry with tests.
